description: Dynamic Venice Elite 2-Person Ultra-Low EMF (Between 3-5 mg) Far Infrared Sauna - Canadian Hemlock Introducing the luxurious and innovative Dynamic Ultra-Low EMF Far Infrared Sauna from the Venice Edition - a true masterpiece in relaxation and wellness. Immerse yourself in the healing power of far-infrared heat and experience a new level of tranquility. Crafted with precision and care, the Dynamic Sauna boasts advanced Ultra-Low EMF technology, ensuring a safe and peaceful experience. Feel the stress melt away as the gentle warmth penetrates your body, promoting improved circulation and detoxification. The Venice Edition sauna is not only a statement piece for your home but also a gateway to enhanced well-being. Embrace the transformative benefits of relaxation and rejuvenation with this exquisite addition to your space. Elevate your life and discover a haven of bliss with the Dynamic Ultra-Low EMF Far Infrared Sauna - the epitome of luxury and holistic indulgence. Features 2-person capacity Ultra Low EMF - EMF Between 3 to 5 mg 2 to 3 inches from the heating panels Music System w/Bluetooth Capability and 2 dynamic speakers with pre-amp (no radio included) Interior and exterior LED control panel Natural hemlock wood construction Electrical service: 120V/15amp Clasp together assembly 6 Carbon PureTech™ Ultra Low EMF Heat Emitters (Heating Panels) Tempered glass door Interior reading/chromotherapy lighting system Roof vent Specifications Exterior dimensions (WDH): 50" x 42" x 77" (roof overhang: add 4.2") Interior dimensions (WDH): 43" x 37" x 70" Sauna weight: 375 lbs. Shipping weight: 425 lbs. Ships in 3 boxes All Golden Designs Saunas Include a 5-Year Limited Warranty. View more details here. What are you waiting for?
